role: Process-local inode/WAL lock policy and deferred physical close below complete namespace operations; not a new public storage API.
scope_preserved: Existing ten tables,31 SQL operations,five storage classes,arbitrary-precision TEXT clock values and all public limits remain unchanged and outside this component. No global descriptor/row/byte count quota.

dependencies.provider: Real selected HIANFR03 FS owner; stat15,fcntl17,close8. Typed peer frames below never authenticate a foreign process.

references.scope: Root/path/UID and exact transaction semantics; only reread, not new execution.
SQLite3.46.1 source branch without SQLITE_ENABLE_SETLK_TIMEOUT; unixShmLock,unixShmSystemLock,robust_close,setPendingFd,closePendingFds. CI SQLite runtime may differ.

semantic_rules: Same-process shared locks are tracked by each live connection. Repeating the same shared acquisition is a no-op.
A shared acquire with other shared holders needs no physical F_SETLK; releasing one shared holder does not physically unlock while another holds it.
Exclusive requests first check same-inode per-connection shared/exclusive masks. An in-process conflict returns SQLITE_BUSY without an OS lock request.
The eight lock bits are the existing SQLite WAL ABI at byte120..127, not a new namespace resource quota. Shared operations span exactly one bit; exclusive operations may span a contiguous range.

A completed known physical F_SETLK error maps to SQLITE_BUSY for every errno under the selected3.46.1 non-timeout source branch. Raw errno remains in the receipt. Failed unlock leaves all masks unchanged.

A logical connection must have released its own lock masks before RETIRE; this is an internal typed precondition, not public AgentStore.close. The future full coordinator must execute the complete close sequence.

RETIRE becomes logically unavailable immediately. If any same-inode masks remain, the physical descriptor is queued. When the group has no masks, queued descriptors are physically closed in reverse retirement order.

Each CLOSE token is removed before issuing exactly one physical request. Completed close errors are recorded and ignored for business success as robust_close does; close is never retried after EINTR or another known errno.
Unknown physical result or invalid/replayed framing permanently poisons this registry and retains the pending action metadata. It does not synthesize an unlock,close,rollback or durable commit.
UID0,device0,and inode0 are ordinary numeric values; root ownership/type policy is a separate stage and is not silently inferred from nonzero tests.

statuses.2: grow workspace before the first stat; re-enter same original source lease

commands.5: retire a fully unlocked logical registry handle

commands.7: peer outcome unknown: exact active call/action, no payload; permanent refusal

7 expected physical op for ACK;0 for new
9 new REGISTER FS token, or LOCK kind1shared/2exclusive; INIT FSnonce high
11 INIT previous FS call watermark, otherwise0

workspace_rows.growth: Sixteen rows per allocation request. This is allocation granularity; repeated growth has no record-count quota. All additions/multiplications are checked against u64 addressability before use.
workspace_rows.handles: Nonzero,monotonic,never reused; no claim that a numeric handle authenticates external input.

peer_binding: ACK includes the exact actual FS command buffer and exact completed output buffer. The FS request has selected FS nonce,operation,token/type/range and source lease equal to this registry action.
The completed FS reply must match that request's nonce/call/operation/source lease,have version3/phaseREADY/statusCOMPLETE and advance the observed FS call/sysseq watermarks.

All FS request reserved words and complete-reply reserved/shape words are checked. Stat success includes the full144-byte native struct; duplicate header dev/ino/mode/UID/GID/size/nlink fields must equal those actual payload bytes.

The caller must possess the real selected FS-session lease and pass the request/reply from the actual just-completed invocation. This component cannot prove origin from fabricated bytes; a fixed native coordinator/IO issuer still has to enforce that provenance.

Other physical I/O may advance the FS watermarks between registry calls,so matching actual call is strictly newer,not assumed adjacent. The fixed whole coordinator must prevent raw close/fcntl bypass for registered inodes. Arbitrary side-channel closes are not covered.
pending_consistency: REGISTER stat15 is only legal after saved command2 and its token,zero range,zero drain metadata.
fcntl17 is only legal after saved LOCK3/UNLOCK4 with exact kind,range,row handle,token and expected actual lock type.
close8 is only legal after saved UNLOCK4/RETIRE5 while draining an unmasked inode group; retiring handle is issued and provider token has already been retired from rows.
Deferred rows carry distinct positive retirement sequence values; scans do not accept ambiguous LIFO order.
